summary: RCA + fix verified: the reported 'blank white screen on /client' was caused by Metro running in CI mode (CI=true) which disables file watching / hot reload. The browser was being served a stale bundle from an earlier broken state. After `sudo supervisorctl restart expo` the new bundle is built and ALL routes render correctly: / (home), /client (red HOLA CATALOGO placeholder), /client/calendar (2 events from API), /client/contact (3 contact cards), /admin/login (form works), /admin/dashboard (renders after login with admin/admin123). Backend integration is working — calendar fetches events, login authenticates successfully and navigates to dashboard. No console pageerrors, no red screen. Deprecation warnings detected: 'shadow*' style props and props.pointerEvents (cosmetic React Native Web warnings only).

rca_of_issue: Root cause of blank white screen on /client: Metro bundler is started with CI=true (visible in expo logs: 'Metro is running in CI mode, reloads are disabled'). When E1 edited client/_layout.tsx and client/index.tsx during debugging, Metro did NOT rebuild — the browser was served the previous broken bundle (the build that had the SafeAreaProvider/GestureHandlerRootView/Tabs experiments). Reproduction: edit any file under /app/frontend/app/client/ → reload browser → see old broken bundle. Mitigation: run `sudo supervisorctl restart expo` after every code change. After restart, /client and all sub-routes render correctly. Confirmed by visiting /client (red HOLA CATALOGO), /client/calendar (events list), /client/contact (3 cards), /admin/login → /admin/dashboard (admin/admin123 success).
